title: Drop blamed on temporary destocking, but a major customer is also insourcing

input.facts: Immunoassay reagents run on its installed analyzers: reagents and service are 75% of sales. The share price fell 35% after a profit warning that management attributes to temporary customer destocking. In the same quarter, its second-largest customer, a US reference laboratory network worth about 15% of sales, announced it will move these tests to its own in-house platform from 2027. Leverage 2.0x. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: Part of the drop may be structural: losing a customer worth 15% of sales to insourcing is not destocking. The thesis requires a temporary cause; when the drop may be structural, Radar. No kill criterion is met, so not Reject.
